adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, the category passed to `PostCreator` changed from the global `SiteSetting.embed_category` to `eh.try(:category_id)` where `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`. If `record_for_host(url)` returns nil (no matching `EmbeddableHost` row for that URL’s host), `category` becomes nil. The diff also removes the `embed_category` setting entirely (`config/site_settings.yml`, `config/locales/server.en.yml`) and migrates old values away, so there is no longer a configured fallback. This is a behavior change that can result in embedded imports being created without the previously configured category (likely falling back to default/uncategorized depending on `PostCreator`), which matches the finding’s concern.
